lines.en: I was having dinner at a restaurant when Tony Steele came in.
lines.cn: 我正在餐厅吃晚饭，这时托尼·斯蒂尔走了进来。

lines.en: Tony worked in a lawyer's office years ago,
lines.cn: 托尼几年前在一家律师事务所工作过。

lines.en: but he is now working at a bank.
lines.cn: 但他现在在一家银行工作。

lines.en: but he always borrows money from his friends and never pays it back.
lines.cn: 但他总是向朋友借钱，却从不还钱。

lines.en: Tony saw me and came and sat at the same table.
lines.cn: 托尼看到我后，走过来坐在了我的旁边。

lines.en: He has never borrowed money from me.
lines.cn: 他从来没有向我借过钱。

lines.en: While he was eating, I asked him to lend me twenty pounds.
lines.cn: 他正在吃饭的时候，我向他借了二十英镑。

lines.en: To my surprise, he gave me the money immediately.
lines.cn: 令我惊讶的是，他立刻就把钱给了我。

lines.en: 'I have never borrowed any money from you,'
lines.cn: “我从来没有向你借过任何钱。”

lines.en: Tony said, 'so now you can pay for my dinner!'
lines.cn: 托尼说：“现在你可以付我晚餐的钱了！”
